text:
nina: Quick heads-up 1: planning to flip `ember-7b-quant` into the catalog low-latency lane during the Monday change window (2025-09-15 01:00 UTC). Need pinlist, fallback ladder, and clear rollback canned responses.

ryan: Got it. Which services are in-scope? We should isolate high-throughput routes.

nina: In-scope: public-api, websocket-chat, realtime-embed. public-api must keep a pinned slot for 12h after enable. Also request KV prefix prewarm.

sam: Telemetry checklist: p50/p95 token latencies, 4xx/5xx breakdown, tail GPU mem faults, and quick-sample outputs to quality-runner. Add a quick smoke eval for rouge/emd delta.

devops-bot: schedule created 1ember-7b-quant enable: canary 3% at 1769010000, 20% at 1769013600 (15m hold), 100% at 1769017200. Fallback chain global: ember-7b-fp16 -> orion-6b -> fallback-small. EU override: ember-7b-fp16 -> orion-6b (no fallback-small). Auto-rollback: latency +20% OR error rate +1.0% OR smoke-eval regression >1.5%. Alerts to #eng-releases and #oncall.

nina: Prefer keeping orion-6b before fallback-small for semantic closeness. Also prefer quantv3->quantv2 chain if available; avoid raw fp32 unless necessary.

ryan: Confirmed re: order. Also request a soft manual hold at 20% for 15m to inspect traces and sample outputs.

sam: Oncall watch: I'll run eval diffs live. If quality delta >0.8% open an incident and we'll start rollback. Whos oncall for 01:00-05:00 UTC?

tz-rotate: I'm primary for 01:00-05:00 UTC. I'll coordinate with nina on rollback ops.

nina: Ops steps to pre-run 30m before canary:
```
# reserve warm slots
slotctl allocate --service public-api --count 1 --reason "ember enable warm slot"
# kv warm
kv-warm --model ember-7b-quant --prefix /cache/ember --rate 2000 --samples 3000
# set slot pin
catalogctl pin --model ember-7b-quant --services public-api,websocket-chat,realtime-embed --duration 12h
```
I'll execute 30m prior.

devops-bot: ack warmup and pin scheduled. Canary traffic shaper and slot pins applied at canary start.

ryan: Rollback plan: drain canary, revert catalog pin ordering to previous commit, and trigger a deploybot rollback if we see >1% smoke-eval regression or persistent latency tail. Keep cooldown 20m.

nina: Add note: if EU region shows edge-case fallback to fallback-small due to capacity, prefer manual override instead of auto-rollback unless errors or quality regressions occur.

sam: I'll post the release note draft to #release-notes with evaluation snapshot and the exact pinned services. Please include the deploy-bot schedule and rollback thresholds.

nina: Thanks team. ryan/tz-rotate/sam acknowledged the 20% hold. I'll post final checklist 10m before warmup.
